profile.headline: Software Engineer at Bonusly
profile.summary:
What drives me, is the search to find projects, ideas, or concepts that will really make a difference. I want to build. And I want to build things that matter and things that will last! Maybe I've grown up in a social media era where we only see the highlights. But these highlights were never de-motivating to me, in fact, quite the opposite...

From healthcare technology and finance to real estate and film and music production, I have spent time in many fields that I find interesting. However, wherever I focus my time, I always deliver on attention to detail. In my experience, attention to detail is a key differentiator in any field. Its the difference between the good and the great. 

Skills:
- Fluent in full stack software development using Ruby/Rails, Postgres, React, and Vue.
- Strong experience developing software from early state ($0/yr) to mid stage ($3M/year)
- Work very well on teams. Small start up teams to large scale system teams.

I am committed to leveraging my skills and experience to create impactful software solutions. If you're looking for a dedicated professional who can bring value to your team and help drive your projects forward, let's connect. Reach out to me here on LinkedIn – I’d love to discuss how we can work together to achieve great things.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Partnered with sales to identify and prioritize top prospect requirements, translating them into high-impact product features that contributed to a 49% increase in qualified opportunities and nearly doubling pipeline ARR from $936K to $1.9M in a quarter.

- Led cross-functional development of Custom Groups and External Recognition, expanding the platform’s targeting capabilities and enabling the company to serve a new customer segment. Enhanced the Nominations workflow with dynamic questions, custom user groups, and multi-stage voting.

- Team lead on the development of LLM powered, manager focused features that analyzed employee recognition data through prompt engineering and MCP tool calling to generate contextual, actionable insights that improved team performance and engagement.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Led collaboration with product and business teams to develop a new product for pharmaceutical sales reps, generating $3-5 million in annual revenue.

- Architect, designed, developed a scalable full-stack application, database schema, and security implementation.

- Interview, onboard, manage, and delegate ownership of product on development side for 4 incoming developers. Leadership approval led to the hiring of a 7 member development team.

- Continuously iterated on the pilot product based on user feedback, market research, and usage tracking. Enhanced product's market fit, directly contributing to the company's renewal of several 8-figure clients, totaling $20+ million in renewed contracts.

positions.title: Software Developer Apprentice
positions.description:
- Developed and maintained core pharmaceutical products in Ruby on Rails microservice environments.

- Upgraded backend processes for cross-team event handlers and internal API applications

- Improved upon several legacy product applications by creating custom admin UI
and functionality, reducing administrative workload and improving user satisfaction.

positions.title: Android Mobile Application Developer
positions.description:
-	Collaborated on team of 4 to design and develop fully functioning Android application
-	Implemented image capture, upload, and view capabilities 
-	Developed front end processes such as login, navigation, and event handling
-	Successfully deployed private application to Google Play Store

positions.title: Quality Assurance Operations Intern
positions.description:
- Utilized the Splunk data analysis tool to organize and create visualizations of CenturyLink customer complaint data. 
- Developed custom Splunk dashboards using XML to enhance end user functionality
- Optimized Splunk searches of large data sets by over 90%
- Developed python code and scripts to integrate custom functionality to Splunk back-end capabilities

projects.title: OSU Network Vulnerability Scanning
projects.description:
-	Utilized Kali Linux to scan machines on network and return relevant port information
-	Configured OpenVAS vulnerability scanner to search for vulnerabilities on network
-	Created vulnerability assessment reports for machines on network
-	Analyzed and provided vulnerability severity ratings to users on the network

projects.title: Wi-fi Access Point Android Phone Exploit
projects.description:
-	Worked on team of 4 to successfully install application on users connected to custom wi-fi
-	Constructed fake public wi-fi access point with internet forwarding using Kali Linux
-	Configured access point to redirect connected user traffic to custom captive portal
-	Implemented backdoor APK downloaded to phones to allow access to phone function
